title: A declared name is one edit away from `confluent-kafka`
description: Pipfile declares a declared requirement name in Pipfile within one edit of `confluent-kafka`. Pip resolves these names against the configured index, so a name that only looks like the intended project delivers whatever that other project publishes. The name this rule expects is `confluent-kafka`.
remediation: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `confluent-kafka`, correct it to that exact spelling.
limitation: It compares declared names with `confluent-kafka` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `confluent-kafka` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
